verdict.rationale: Superset is documented as local-first, and "your code never leaves your machine unless you say so," which gives users some control over what data leaves the device. The SDK also supports scripted cleanup of tasks across projects. There is no documentation of retention policies, deletion of synced or cloud-held data, or account-level data deletion. Missing for 10: documented retention settings, deletion of server-side/synced data (sessions, automations, shared designs), account/data deletion controls, independent corroboration.
